scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p backend/tsconfig.json && node scripts/package-announcements.mjs && node scripts/package-live-acknowledgement.mjs
scripts.firebase:package: npm run build && node scripts/package-firebase.mjs && node scripts/check-ios-release-package.mjs
scripts.test:firebase: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-shield 'npx vitest run backend/tests/cloud.test.ts backend/tests/forwarding.test.ts backend/tests/monitoring.test.ts backend/tests/alerts.test.ts backend/tests/phone-contacts.test.ts backend/tests/voicemail.test.ts backend/tests/pilot.test.ts backend/tests/setup-check.test.ts backend/tests/shared-pilot.test.ts backend/tests/live-startup-emulator.test.ts backend/tests/backend-reliability.test.ts backend/tests/service-access.test.ts'
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:accounts: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.account-tests.json --only firestore,auth --project demo-shield-accounts 'SHIELD_ACCOUNT_EMULATOR_TESTS=1 npx vitest run backend/tests/account-lifecycle.test.ts'
